# Naqaa Cleaning UAE

Static multi-page site (English at `/`, Arabic RTL at `/ar/`) for Vercel. No framework.
**Every HTML page is generated by `build.py`**: edit the source, re-run, never hand-edit output.

## Build

```bash
python3 build.py
```

Writes all pages, `404.html`, `sitemap.xml` (with hreflang), `robots.txt`, `site.webmanifest`,
the social image and icons (needs Pillow), then checks titles, descriptions, one `<h1>` per page,
internal links and JSON-LD. If it stops with ✗, fix what it lists and run again.

## Where things live

| What | File |
|---|---|
| Domain, WhatsApp/phone, email, licence, analytics IDs | `tools/config.py` (fill the TODOs before launch) |
| Service pages `/services/<slug>/` | `content/services.py` |
| Emirate pages `/locations/<slug>/` | `content/locations.py` |
| Home, hubs, quote, about, contact, FAQ, legal | `content/pages.py` |
| Page shell, `<head>` SEO, header/footer, components, UI strings | `tools/layout.py` |
| Styles / quote form script | `assets/site.css`, `assets/site.js` |

Adding a service or emirate: add the entry (both `en` and `ar`) in `content/`, add its slug to
`SERVICES`/`LOCATIONS` in `tools/config.py`, run the build. Menus, footer, cross links, sitemap
and structured data update automatically.

## SEO rules
- Unique `title` (≤ ~60 chars) and `desc` (120–155 chars) per page and language.
- Every page exists in both languages (hreflang pairs are generated from the same path).
- Internal links inside content use the language prefix (`/ar/...` on Arabic pages).

## Content rules
- No made-up prices, statistics, reviews, guarantees, licences or approvals. Add them only when the owner confirms.
- No pest control until the municipality permit exists.
- Commit messages in English; talk to the owner in Egyptian Arabic.
